notes: Variant assumption is a flat floor bodyweight reverse crunch with a compact posterior pelvic tilt. Escamilla et al. studied a harder 30-degree incline reverse crunch, so that evidence is interpreted as reverse-crunch-family support rather than exact flat-floor scoring. The exact ACE report is useful for flat reverse crunch and grouped obliques but is not peer-reviewed, so it is paired with peer-reviewed abdominal EMG studies.
